description: Search for emails in your inbox with flexible filters. Optionally get full email content and attachments. Use this to find specific emails, check for unread messages, or browse your inbox.

account_name.description: Name of the email account to use (e.g., 'work', 'personal'). If not provided, uses the default account.

filters.description: Structured filters for precise email search

after_date.description: Filter emails after this date (ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD)

before_date.description: Filter emails before this date (ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD)

include_content.description: Include full email body content in results

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return (1-100)

query.description: Text to search across subject, body, sender, and recipients (e.g., 'project update')

name: emails_find
